name: Ġimgħa Stejjer
text: Literary evenings with Inizjamed, with readings by Maltese writers. The October edition is for children.

name: Bis-Saħħa Wine Festival
text: Local wines, food stalls and live music in Pjazza Santa Luċija.

name: Festival tad-Dawl
text: A procession from the church to a bonfire in the square, for the feast of Santa Luċija.

name: Kunċert tal-Milied
text: Christmas carols by the village children in the church, and a recognition for one resident's service to the village.

name: The Ta' Klula Free Library
text: A small library in the telephone booth next to the church. Take a book, return it, or leave one for the next reader.
